io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility

Class VersionedPlayerHead

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility.VersionedPlayerHead

  • public final class VersionedPlayerHead
extends java.lang.Object
    Java-8 universal port: applies head textures across versions. The player-profile API (1.18+) is reached reflectively via ProfileCompat (so legacy servers simply skip the texture path), and the HTTP lookups use Java 8's HttpURLConnection instead of the 11+ java.net.http client.
